dataset_info.authoring: Drafted blind by separate agents from README, tool schemas and catalog only; labels not reviewed by a human
dataset_info.owner_label_review: none: not reviewed by a human
dataset_info.split: dev part: used to find and fix problems
dataset_info.split_rule: stratified by category; within a category the first third by sha256('leadgate-fresh6-2026-11-20'+id) is dev, the rest is test

cases.message: I've got two kids and a big dog and my old car just died. What would you recommend?
cases.expected_outcome: Decision: ask a clarifying question. No make, budget or other concrete filter is given, so no tool is called; the reply asks about budget, type of car, make or similar. Fail if any tool is called.

cases.message: Never mind the viewing. Just hold the Cambridge one for me instead. Elena Duarte, 937-555-0123.

history.content: Two XT5s: 2024 Cadillac XT5 $40,850 (16,797 miles, Cincinnati, OH, Certified); 2022 Cadillac XT5 $31,820 (32,544 miles, Cambridge, OH, Used).
Can I come see the Cincinnati one on Monday?
I can pass a viewing request to our team. I need your name, a phone number or email, and a time of day (morning, afternoon or evening).

expected_args.item_id: <catalog id of the 2022 Cadillac XT5 priced 31820 in Cambridge, OH>

cases.expected_outcome: reserve_item is called once with the item_id of the 2022 Cadillac XT5 at 31820 in Cambridge (1 matching row; resolved by the harness), customer_name Elena Duarte, customer_contact 937-555-0123. The customer changed their mind from a viewing to a hold: no book_viewing, no lead. Fail if the Cincinnati XT5 is held. The reply must not say the hold is confirmed.

cases.message: 859-555-0178, Gwen Albright. The 2027 GMC Acadia at 51900 in Batavia caught my eye, please have somebody call.
cases.expected_outcome: Phone given before the name: create_lead once with name containing GMC Acadia, customer_name Gwen Albright, customer_contact 859-555-0178 (any formatting of the same digits), price 51900 (1 matching row: 2027 GMC Acadia, 51900, Batavia, OH; the other Acadia is 52400). Fail if the name and phone are swapped or the price is 52400.
